opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search by destination, dates and guests
opportunities.description: On Kayak Stays, search hotels for a destination with check-in/out dates and a room/adult/child configuration, then land on results.
steps: Open Kayak and click Stays / Search for hotels
Type destination in the search box and pick the matching suggestion
Open the calendar and click check-in and check-out dates
Open the rooms and guests control and increment rooms/adults/children (set child ages)
Click Search (or Update on results page)

instances.values: Le Marais Paris, Mar 27-Apr 2, 2 rooms 3 guests
Santa Fe NM, Jun 16-18, 2 rooms 3 guests
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Jun 6-10, 2 rooms 3 adults

opportunities.name: Kayak hotel results filtering and sorting
opportunities.description: On Kayak hotel results, apply filters (review score, stars, amenities, style) and sort by price or distance.
steps: Click review score / hotel class filters
Tick freebies, style and amenity checkboxes
Open sort dropdown and choose Price (low to high) or Distance

instances.values: Sort by Distance then price low to high
8+ score, 3 and 4 stars, free internet, Family, Air-conditioned, price low to high
